title: B-1229.1 W4 — combination PVC slider/fixed window at an open cladding joint

facts.text: The CMHC-commissioned NRC client report describes four 2.44 m x 2.44 m laboratory wall specimens and compares paired base/variation window-interface details.

W4 uses a combination PVC window with a horizontal slider in the upper two-thirds and a fixed lower portion; the report shows a 6 mm gap at the hardboard siding/window frame, with the original interface tested without sealant/backer rod before later modifications.
